findings.description: The KMS key omits enable_key_rotation, which defaults to false, so the key material protecting the logs bucket is never automatically rotated. Long-lived static key material increases the blast radius of a key compromise and fails common cryptographic key management requirements.

No policy argument is supplied, so AWS applies the default key policy that delegates full control of the key to the account root, allowing any IAM principal in the account that can be granted kms:* through IAM to decrypt data protected by this key. An explicit least-privilege key policy scoping usage to the log-writing service and named administrators would provide defence in depth.
